svg.metadata: {"id": "s029", "name": "博物馆展厅", "cat": "语文与历史", "tags": ["历史", "语文", "传统文化", "美术"], "desc": "安静的博物馆展厅：中央墙上长卷山水，两侧玻璃展柜中陈列青铜鼎、青花瓷瓶、彩陶罐和玉璧，顶灯投下光束。", "stand": {"ground_y": 910, "x": [600, 1320]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "scroll", "enter": "zoom", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "labels", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "track_lights", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.4, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "beams", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.8, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "ding", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "vase", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "small_plinths", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.75, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "stanchions", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.9, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "glints", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.2, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#E9E3DA", "wall2": "#D8CFC2", "panel": "#3C4A57", "panel2": "#2E3A45", "floor1": "#C9BBA8", "floor2": "#A99A86", "plinth": "#F7F4EE", "plinth2": "#DCD5C9", "glass": "#E6F4F7", "bronze": "#4F8A7A", "bronze2": "#3A6E62", "bronze3": "#7FB3A0", "blue": "#2E5C9E", "porc": "#F8F7F2", "clay": "#C9774A", "clay2": "#9E5634", "jade": "#9FCFB4", "gold": "#E2B860", "light": "#FFF2D0", "rope": "#B8433C", "scroll": "#F3E8D0", "ink": "#5E6A6A", "ink2": "#8FA3A0"}}
